target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Primary county-level zoning authority coordinating with 27 townships. Maintains comprehensive zoning contact directory and provides educational resources for township zoning officials. Three townships (Monroe, Richmond, Windsor) do not have township zoning resolutions. Links to township zoning resolutions provided when digital editions available. Specific zoning questions referred to township zoning officials. MVP could integrate with existing infrastructure to provide digital permit routing and status tracking across multi-jurisdictional landscape.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Largest city in Ashtabula County with active zoning enforcement. Issues zoning permits required before county building permits can be obtained. Review process takes up to one week. Permits picked up at office with fees due (fees vary). Applications for swimming pools, sheds, decks, garages, and new businesses. PDF forms must be printed, filled out, and returned - opportunity for digital transformation. Can fax to (440) 992-7180 or email to PCD@cityofashtabula.com. MVP would streamline application process and provide online submission and tracking.
